> India's trusted franchise growth platform connecting brands, investors, and expansion leaders.

## Organization
- Name: iFranchise
- Type: Franchise consulting and marketplace platform

## Primary services
- Franchise opportunity discovery for investors
- Franchise expansion consulting for brands
- Investor matching and lead generation
- Franchise documentation and onboarding support
- Market research and territory planning
